faq.title: Property listings and tools: common questions
faq.a1: 360Ghar provides property listings and related real-estate tools. Availability and details vary by market and page.
faq.q2: Does every listing include a virtual tour?
faq.a2: No. A 360° tour appears only when the listing provides one. Check the listing details.
faq.a3: Do not assume a listing has been independently verified. Check the property, owner, price and documents with the relevant parties before paying.
faq.q4: Are there fees for listing a property?
faq.a4: Check the current listing form and terms for applicable fees.
faq.q5: Can I get help with a property search?
faq.a5: Support options depend on the service. Use the contact information shown on the relevant page.

structuredFaq.a1: 360Ghar helps people search property listings and use related real-estate tools. Listing availability and data coverage vary by market.
structuredFaq.a2: Use the listing form to submit property details. Review the current terms and form before submitting; submitted details may be subject to review.
structuredFaq.a3: Do not assume a listing has been independently verified. Confirm the property, owner, price and documents with the relevant parties before you pay.
structuredFaq.q4: What does a 360° virtual tour show?
structuredFaq.a4: A 360° tour, when a listing includes one, shows captured views of that property. It does not replace an in-person visit or document checks.
structuredFaq.q5: Are there fees for listing a property?
structuredFaq.a5: Check the current listing form and terms for any applicable fees. 360Ghar does not confirm the cost of a specific transaction.
structuredFaq.a6: Gurugram, Delhi, Noida, Faridabad and Ghaziabad are target markets. This does not confirm listing availability in each one. Search current inventory.
structuredFaq.q7: Can I choose a home using only a virtual tour?
structuredFaq.a7: A tour is a viewing aid. Visit the property and verify its details before you agree to a transaction.
structuredFaq.q8: Do all users get a relationship manager?
structuredFaq.a8: Support options depend on the service. Check the contact details shown for your account or transaction.
structuredFaq.a9: Compare listing details, total costs, location and documents. Confirm each item with the owner or relevant authority.
structuredFaq.a10: This site does not confirm RERA approval for each property or project. Check the relevant official RERA register using the exact registration details.
